description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Gladiolus (Earth)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Gladiolus (Earth)
description.text: Increases [Earth Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Gladiolus (Earth) after using a Earth ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Royal Guard+
description.text: Six single attacks (1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, grants [20% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Gladiolus (Earth)
description.text: Six single attacks (0.80/0.90 each) with a higher multiplier if hitting Earth weakness, grants [Earth Ability Instant Cast 3] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
